content.text: {"stage":"complete-Claim entailment","claims":[{"index":0,"text":"원문 작성 시점에 원문 화자는 요즘 매일 아침 6시에 일어나는 중이다.","evidence":[{"quote":"요즘 매일 아침 6시에 일어나는 중"}],"source_meaning":"The original utterance states that the speaker is currently in the ongoing pattern of waking at 6 AM every morning, a recent-period habit in progress.","candidate_meaning":"At the time the original text was written, the original speaker is in the ongoing pattern of waking at 6 AM every morning.","dimensions":{"attribution":{"reason":"The speaker role 원문 화자 is the intrinsic original speaker of the source sentence, so no extra attribution is added.","status":"pass"},"polarity_scope":{"reason":"Both are affirmative ongoing-habit assertions with no negation, modality or conditional scope.","status":"pass"},"missing_argument":{"reason":"The waking event needs only the time and actor, both of which are supplied in the candidate; no required argument is missing.","status":"pass"},"unsupported_inference":{"reason":"The candidate adds no causal, emotional or purpose content beyond the source's ongoing morning routine.","status":"pass"},"korean_meaning":{"reason":"The Korean dependent form 일어나는 중이다 preserves the progressive meaning of 일어나는 중 and the recurring 매일 아침 6시 pattern.","status":"pass"},"source_meta_expansion":{"reason":"The candidate adds no commentary about the document; the time anchor 원문 작성 시점 is the source-relative current period.","status":"pass"},"entailment":{"reason":"The candidate preserves the ongoing recurring waking pattern in the source-relative current period, and the narrower writing-time anchor still matches the source's 요즘 ongoing frame.","status":"pass"}},"uncertainty_flags":[],"violations":[]}],"inventory":[],"uncertainty_flags":[],"verdict":"pass"}
